snippet.title: Half-Life 2: Inhuman - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A Half-Life 2 mod pushing the limits at every opportunity. Revamped weapons. Deadlier Enemies. A new hostile world to experience.

Take on the role of a reprogrammed cyborg soldier, set against its former masters in a desperate bid to save the resistance.

Learn more here: 
https://www.moddb.com/mods/inhuman
https://twitter.com/Anticitizensdev
https://twitter.com/ComfortJonez

If you'd like to support my work: https://www.patreon.com/comfortjones
